title: Data Protection
subtitle: Dr. Chamssi & Dr. Tazi are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🖥️

Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi are two passionate dentists. One has digitized everything, the other remains faithful to paper. But one question unites them: are they properly protecting their patients' data?

Between Law 09-08, the CNDP, declarations, authorizations, transfers abroad, and cookies... the path is full of obstacles.

Poor management, an oversight, and it's a fine of 100,000 DH that threatens their practice. 💸

The confidentiality of their patients, their reputation, their peace of mind rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi are two passionate dentists. One has digitized everything, the other remains faithful to paper. But one question unites them: are they properly protecting their patients' data? They discover the basics of Law 09-08 and the obligations towards the CNDP.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi deepen their knowledge of data protection: archiving, video surveillance, backups, electronic signatures. They must secure their patients' data.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi face complex situations: CNDP declarations, sensitive data, information notices. They must master compliance to protect their patients.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi manage data transfers, cloud hosting, subcontracting contracts. They must secure data while respecting the law.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi become references in dental data protection. They train young dentists in compliance and digital ethics.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and commitment, Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of data protection skills and excellence to the dental profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi have laid the foundations of data protection. But the road is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Legal obligations are mastered. Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi are ready to secure their data.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Compliance is mastered. Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Transfers and security are mastered. Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Protection strategy has become a key skill. Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Chamssi and Dr. Tazi have accomplished their mission. Data protection is a guarantee of trust and ethics.
